reference.policy: bit-exact default on every row outside the fixed sparse gate

gate.component_spread: max(base, uniform_0425, persistence) - min(base, uniform_0425, persistence)
gate.input_outlier_rule: each physical diagnostic train-fold winsorized at q01/q99 before rank calculation; no row deletion
gate.fixed_rule: component_spread train ECDF rank >=0.90 AND max physical diagnostic train ECDF rank >=0.90

candidates.name: P3_1_EXTREME_DISAGREEMENT_PERSISTENCE_QUARTER_FALLBACK
candidates.action: on gated rows prediction = 0.75*uniform_0425 + 0.25*persistence; otherwise exact uniform_0425

candidates.name: P3_2_EXTREME_DISAGREEMENT_THREE_COMPONENT_MEDIAN
candidates.action: on gated rows prediction = median(base, uniform_0425, persistence); otherwise exact uniform_0425

validation.surface_claim: EXPLORATORY_ONLY on repeatedly exposed 182 historical cases; no Public transport guarantee

decision.stable: delta RMSE vs uniform <0; >=4/6 blocks; episode and block-station CI90 upper <0; worst station-lead <=0.01m
decision.high_risk_preserve: delta RMSE vs uniform <=-0.005m and worst station-lead <=0.02m

duplication_audit.novel_axis: target-free sparse robust fallback using persistence as a third independent component and training-only physical-extreme diagnostics
